# Public-domain subtitle fixture

`duck_and_cover_excerpt.srt` is a short excerpt adapted from dialogue in
*Duck and Cover* (1951). Timings and line wrapping were prepared specifically
for parser testing rather than copied from a third-party subtitle file.

The film was produced for the United States Federal Civil Defense
Administration. Wikimedia Commons identifies it as a United States federal
government work in the public domain and marks it as free of known copyright
restrictions:

- https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Duck_And_Cover_(1951)_Bert_The_Turtle.webm
- https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/

The excerpt deliberately contains multiple cues, multi-line dialogue, inline
italics, punctuation, a repeated character name, and organization names so it
can exercise more realistic subtitle parsing than a one-line synthetic sample.
